subject.title: Google Chat: Add user OAuth support for reactions and media uploads

question: Should the bundled Google Chat plugin add a first-class user OAuth credential surface for reactions, uploads, and proactive DM lookup now, or should OpenClaw continue with service-account-only behavior plus narrower fallbacks?
rationale: This is not a mechanical bug fix: it adds new credential/config surface, OAuth scope routing, token refresh behavior, and security expectations for an alpha channel plugin.

options.title: Approve plugin-owned user OAuth design
options.body: Implement OAuth only inside the Google Chat plugin with SecretRef/redaction support, scoped clients, docs, and tests for absent-OAuth fallback; this is the recommended path if maintainers want parity for these operations.

options.title: Limit current work to fallbacks
options.body: Land or close the media-link fallback PRs separately and leave reactions/uploads/proactive DMs unsupported until a broader OAuth design is sponsored.

options.title: Defer bundled OAuth
options.body: Keep service-account-only Google Chat in core and ask for an external plugin or design proposal if the credential model is not worth adding to the bundled plugin yet.

recommendation.title: Approve plugin-owned user OAuth design
recommendation.body: Implement OAuth only inside the Google Chat plugin with SecretRef/redaction support, scoped clients, docs, and tests for absent-OAuth fallback; this is the recommended path if maintainers want parity for these operations.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete posted the prior maintainer-side review on this exact issue and appears as the committer/reviewer on several foundational Google Chat changes.
